Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: South
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 02/22/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 341 as introduced authorizes a community corrections and punishment authority to establish a subunit for the purpose of apprehension and investigation of criminal offenders, which could increase the obligations of an authority by an undetermined amount that establishes a subunit for law enforcement purposes.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government
